4_detector_calibration.status: PROVISIONAL ONLY - does not satisfy the spec as written
4_detector_calibration.detail: run/config/calibration_provisional.json: 12 documents (6 known-crediting companies, 6 known non-crediting incl. 3 competitor-comparison and 2 wrong-vendor + 1 security-filing-style), text sourced from WebSearch's synthesized answers (not raw fetched bytes, since no working live-fetch mechanism exists yet for body text). Result: 0 false positives / 6 non-crediting docs (spec threshold is <=1/15), 4/6 true positives detected despite paraphrased/non-verbatim text, 2 acceptable false negatives (become 'Not Found', not wrong answers), both wrong-vendor collisions (Costar Technologies, Corning Costar) correctly excluded. This is a reasonable sanity check that the matcher's discrimination logic (phrase list + negation window + wrong-vendor list + security-filing filter) is sound, but it is NOT the spec-required 15+15 calibration against fetched bytes, because fetched bytes are not currently obtainable at the needed fidelity. Must be re-run for real once a live-fetch mechanism is confirmed.

5_write_gate_dry_run.detail: run/config/write_gate_dry_run.json: 5 synthetic bad rows (placeholder entity name, CoStar-owned-host source, LinkedIn source, missing evidence date, Callable=Yes with missing trigger fields) each rejected for the expected reason; 1 control row correctly accepted. run/config/file_lock_test.json: flock-guarded concurrent writers (2 writers x 300 appends) produced exactly 600 intact lines, 0 malformed/interleaved - the lock holds.

overall_status: BLOCKED - Phase One should not start until Scott decides how to resolve the live-fetch gap
blocking_issue: The spec's core evidentiary method - fetch the live page, quote the exact credit sentence verbatim, derive a date from what's visibly printed on the page (or HTTP Last-Modified, or PDF metadata) - has no reliable, cost-bounded execution path in this environment as currently provisioned. WebFetch/Bash cannot reach the target domains at all (org network policy). Site_Scraper can reach them but its MCP surface returns structured metadata rather than article body text, so it cannot confirm or quote an in-body 'Source: CoStar' sentence, and its real-world cost (51 credits for one page in the single test run) makes budgeting for ~400+ verification fetches unpredictable. WebSearch can find real candidate URLs and even surfaces plausible-sounding facts from them, but its output is an LLM paraphrase, not fetched bytes, so using it as an Evidence Excerpt source would itself violate the write gate's anti-fabrication rule. This is exactly the class of problem section 14 (stop conditions) asks to be reported rather than worked around: 'a bar in this document turns out to be unworkable in practice... say which bar and why, and propose the change.'
proposed_options_for_scott: A. Run this project from an environment/session whose network egress policy allows WebFetch/Bash to reach the open web directly (a different Claude Code environment, or a policy change to this one) - restores the spec's original methodology almost exactly, with WebSearch standing in for Bright Data SERP.

B. Provide a working Bright Data (or comparable) credential/MCP connection - if it's MCP-hosted (server-side fetch, like Site_Scraper), it may bypass this session's egress block the same way Site_Scraper does, worth testing once available.

C. Approve continued use of Site_Scraper as the fetch mechanism with an explicit credit cap, accepting that: (i) verification will lean on structured metadata (title, meta description, JSON-LD, canonical URL, page dates from meta tags) rather than true body-text quotations wherever a page's CoStar credit line lives only in prose, which will lower the callable yield versus the spec's design; (ii) per-page cost is unpredictable due to bot-challenge unblocking and should be monitored live, not assumed at ~1 credit/page.

D. Some combination: use WebSearch for discovery and initial screening at full scale (free, fast, already working), then spend Site_Scraper credits only on the smaller set of documents that clear that screen, to control cost.
not_yet_started: Phase One (the 25-row proof slice) has not begun. No rows exist in run/hits.csv beyond the header.
